name: Short-Term Markets & Funding
description: Repo, money markets, and short-dated cash products: rates, haircuts, and funding structure.

metrics.name: repo_rate
metrics.description: Repo rate for the trade or index

metrics.name: spread_to_benchmark
metrics.description: Rate minus a named benchmark (e.g., SOFR)

metrics.name: funding_balance
metrics.description: Repo or money-market balance at a point in time

conventions.rule: Taxonomy, economic viewpoint, sign conventions, and lifecycle follow knowledge/short_term_markets; this pack adds analytics defaults only.
State the economic viewpoint (cash lender or cash borrower); the same trade is repo for one and reverse repo for the other.
Money-market rates are generally ACT/360; state the convention.

insight_rules.reason: Rates are balance-weighted; attribute via mix and rate effects.

caveats.text: Month- and quarter-end balance-sheet constraints distort repo rates and volumes; compare like calendar positions.

chart_conventions.rule: Show rate differences to benchmark in bps on a line chart with month- and quarter-ends marked.

review.notes: Drafted from public, general industry conventions; not yet reviewed by a named domain owner.
